root_cause.text: The driver did not validate the length of a management frame before accessing fields within an ADDBA Request action frame, allowing an out-of-bounds read if a short frame is received.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a length check `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 + 1 + 2` before dereferencing `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.capab`. The original code only checked the action frame category and action code but omitted the length check, as stated in the commit message: "Check frame length before accessing the mgmt fields in mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211 in order to avoid a possible oob access."
